definition: The system WebKit browser engine (same as Safari); used by Tabchat to display services
A web app or website (WhatsApp, Discord, Teams, etc.) shown in a sidebar tab
One instance of a service; the app can have multiple tabs of the same service (e.g. two WhatsApp accounts)
A `WKWebsiteDataStore` for one sign-in; shared by related services (e.g. Teams, Outlook, OneDrive via "microsoft-work")
A count badge on a service tab, the Dock icon and menu bar
macOS notification Focus modes; Tabchat respects them before showing notifications
